headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Main motion as amended: recommend passage of Bill 131 on first reading
meeting.summary: The committee voted on Bills 142 and 132, approved a new Bill 131 draft, and deferred its Emergency Fund review.
meeting.recap: A new draft of Bill 131 makes a quarterly reporting requirement mandatory and fixes a code reference.[[0:18:42]] The budget director said about $78 million is left in the fund.[[0:33:02]] Soil washed down from Kīhei will be reused as cover material at the landfill.[[0:38:45]] Emergency management staff said standby contracts are being set up for generators and buses.[[0:42:12]] A County administrator agreed to gather an itemized list of fund spending.[[0:53:40]] A member said state lawmakers need to write a new dam and reservoir safety bill next term.[[1:07:43]]
decided: Members voted on Bill 131 as amended; the count was read as "9-9-0" and the result was not stated in the captions.
meeting.next: Emergency management staff said they will look into pricing standby contracts on a sliding scale tied to fuel prices.

moments.q: "we are not requesting the amendment at this time"
